values.reopens: closure order runs through October 30, 2026, unless rescinded
values.note: Forest order 01-11-82-26-04 prohibits entering or using Pine Grove Campground from May 26, 2026 through October 30, 2026: 'Due to poor forest health and the presence of Ips Beetles and Tomentosus Root disease, trees are tipping over with little to no warning.' No 2027 opening announced.

status.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/alerts/pine-grove-campground-closure ('This Order shall be in effect from May 26, 2026 at 8:00 am through October 30, 2026 at 8:00 am, unless rescinded.', 'Entering or using a recreation site or portion thereof (Pine Grove Campground)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $15 a night including one vehicle, $5 each additional vehicle; fees charged May - September.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/pine-grove-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night', '$15.00 includes 1 driving vehicle', '$5 each additional vehicle', 'Fees Charged May – September, Weather Dependent'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Bear-resistant dumpster; some sites have bear-resistant food lockers. No firewood sold. No camp host.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/pine-grove-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site', 'Trash Pickup: Bear resistant dumpster on site', 'Some sites equipped with bear resistant food storage lockers', 'Firewood: No', 'Host: No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service 'Seasons of Use: 5/26 - 9/6.' Weather dependent.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/pine-grove-campground ('Seasons of Use 5/26 - 9/6. Fees Charged May – September, Weather Dependent.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No reservation system; very popular and may fill on summer weekends and holidays, so arrive early.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/pine-grove-campground ('This campground does not use a reservation system; it is managed on a first-come, first-served basis', 'There is a 16 day stay limit'), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Beartooth RD) campground in the trees along West Rosebud Creek in the West Rosebud drainage, SW of Fishtail (9.1 mi up West Rosebud Rd past the second turn); two entrances. Emerald Lake Campground, West Rosebud Trail #19 and two fishing accesses are in the same drainage. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run (Beartooth RD), first-come first-served. TEMPORARILY CLOSED: forest order through Oct 30, 2026 (hazard trees: Ips beetles, root disease). Confirmed $15 (+$5 extra vehicle), 46 sites, 30-ft trailers, vault toilets, potable water, FCFS; added season 05-26 to 09-06, 16-day limit, status. Note trimmed of restated values.
